organisation.name: UNBOUND
facts: UNBOUND is an outsourced marketing department for startups and growing brands.

One UNBOUND retainer covers a fractional CMO, brand, product marketing, growth hacking, PR, social media, SEO/SEM and content, sales enablement, website development and optimisation, and media strategy.
The two founders lead every UNBOUND account themselves.
UNBOUND uses AI in its workflow for research, drafting, reporting and testing, with people making the decisions.
UNBOUND clients receive a monthly report as a PowerPoint deck.
UNBOUND offers a free 30-minute call with the founders, booked at https://weunbound.com/#book.

people.name: Amisha Sethi
facts: More than 21 years in marketing leadership.
Led marketing at BlackBerry, AirAsia, Airtel and Locus.
Named among the Top 50 Brand Leaders by Bloomberg and CMO Asia in 2012.
Kellogg executive scholar, with an MBA from Amity.

people.name: Himani Sharma
facts: More than nine years in brand marketing and partnerships.
Senior Brand Marketing Manager at FPSB India, leading brand strategy and stakeholder engagement for the CFP certification.
Earlier roles at ACCA and NestAway Technologies.
Ran an IIM Bangalore bootcamp and an IIM Ahmedabad workshop, each with more than 300 attendees.
B.Com (Hons.) from the University of Delhi.
